title: Customer reply follow-up notes
summary: This topic is mostly brief follow-up statements from customers, with only a few fragments expressing clear opinions about vehicle size or a suspected camera issue.

positive.summary: The positive review praises the smaller dimensions of the earlier model as the right size for the customer.

negative.summary: The negative reviews mention a suspected camera problem and a conditional plan to act if an issue happens again, but examples are limited.

undetermined.summary: Most fragments are status updates about timing, availability, charging setup, drop-off, or lack of questions without enough context to infer sentiment.

limitations: The topic clusters many short callback or service follow-up replies rather than a single coherent vehicle issue.
Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so the concrete sentiment evidence is sparse.
Some negative fragments are too brief to identify the underlying problem beyond a suspected camera issue.
